item.title: Denzel Boston: Listed as questionable for Sunday
item.description:
Boston (quadriceps) will be listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Raiders, Scott Petrak of the Elyria Chronicle-Telegram reports.

item.title: Tetairoa McMillan: Not in uniform Friday
item.description:
Updating a previous report, McMillan (foot) took part in Friday's team stretch but wasn't in uniform, Joe Person of The Athletic reports.

item.title: Romeo Doubs: Unlikely to return Sunday
item.description:
Head coach Mike Vrabel said Friday that Doubs (shoulder) likely won't play in Sunday's game against the Chargers, Evan Lazar of the Patriots' official site reports.

item.title: A.J. Brown: Ruled out for Sunday's game
item.description:
